nodes.title: SG-5.6.1 Land the Phaser alias in a Verify-owned unit
nodes.body:
Context: game/vitest.config.ts only aliases @game, so a bare 'phaser' import from BootScene (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts L1) does not resolve from game/tests. Desired behavior: the phaser alias is added to the game test configuration as part of a Verify-owned unit so it is not rejected as a test file changed by Act, and an alias unit test passes. Why: scene unit tests with Phaser mocked must resolve it.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given game/vitest.config.ts, when read, then resolve.alias maps 'phaser' to the frontend phaser install and keeps '@game'
- Given the alias test, when run, then it passes
- Given the diff, when reviewed, then vitest.config.ts is changed only by a Verify unit


## Scope
- In scope: game/vitest.config.ts phaser alias
- In scope: alias unit test
- Out of scope: Phaser runtime behavior
- Out of scope: backend
- Preserve: @game alias
- Preserve: existing tests including preload.test.ts mocks


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0 in game/frontend/package.json


## Definition of done
- Alias present and alias test passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · game vitest config aliases phaser, added by a Verify-owned unit
nodes.body:
The alias for 'phaser' pointing to game/frontend/node_modules/phaser is added to game/vitest.config.ts within the Verify unit, since it is a test configuration file, and BootScene's default import of phaser stays compatible with it.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given vitest.config.ts, when loaded, then alias 'phaser' resolves to game/frontend/node_modules/phaser and '@game' still resolves to game/src
- Given BootScene.ts, when read, then it default-imports 'phaser' so the alias applies


## Scope
- In scope: vitest.config.ts alias
- In scope: BootScene import check
- Out of scope: new product behavior
- Preserve: @game alias


## Technical constraints
- Alias path must be computed with fileURLToPath like the @game alias


## Definition of done
- Alias added in Verify unit; test passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Act: Confirm BootScene default-imports phaser for the alias
nodes.body:
No product change is expected: BootScene.ts already uses `import Phaser from 'phaser'` (L1) and extends Phaser.Scene (L19). This unit confirms that and leaves vitest.config.ts to the Verify unit.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given BootScene.ts, when read, then L1 is import Phaser from 'phaser'
- Given the diff, when reviewed, then vitest.config.ts is untouched by this unit


## Scope
- In scope: confirm BootScene import
- Out of scope: vitest.config.ts
- Out of scope: test files
- Preserve: BootScene behavior


## Technical constraints
- Code path: `game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts`


## Definition of done
- BootScene import confirmed unchanged


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Verify: game vitest config phaser alias unit tests
nodes.body:
This Verify unit owns the change to game/vitest.config.ts (a test configuration) and adds the test that asserts the alias, so Act is not rejected for touching test files.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the config, when its alias is read, then phaser maps to game/frontend/node_modules/phaser
- Given the config, when its alias is read, then @game still maps to game/src


## Scope
- In scope: game/vitest.config.ts
- In scope: game/tests/vitestPhaserAlias.test.ts
- Out of scope: product code
- Preserve: existing include glob
- Preserve: @game alias


## Technical constraints
- Only the config file read from disk and the imported config object; no vitest process is started inside the test


## Dependencies
- ACT1


## Definition of done
- Alias added and alias test green


## Clarifying questions
- None
